newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 150 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 150 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.15 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 150 billion dong ($12.85 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.15 percent to domestic and foreign institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on June 25, the central bank sold 100 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.50 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is July 4 and maturity will be on July 4, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 124.5 billion
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 5.0 billion
